exercises.instruction: Read the sign and pick what it means

options: If you don't buy a ticket, you won't get in
We appreciate that you didn't buy a ticket
When you buy a ticket, you'll go inside
items.explanation: takdirde here means “in case.” almadığınız = al + ma + dığınız: “the fact that you didn't buy.”

items.prompt: How do you say “in case you are late” (geç kalmak)?
items.explanation: Before takdirde comes the -DIk form with an owner: kal + dığınız. The -mA form pairs with durumunda.
durumunda takes the -mA form with an owner: çık + ma + sı. Fire is a subject without -ın, it's indefinite.

items.prompt: Which phrase sounds like a sign, not a message to a friend?
items.explanation: -sA (gelmezsen) is the conversational “if.” takdirde is the same condition, but in a suit: contracts, rules, notices.

exercises.instruction: Insert the ending that fits the word after the gap

items.text: Şifrenizi unut___ durumunda yeni şifre alın.
items.translation: If you forget your password, you'll get a new one.
items.explanation: durumunda → the -mA form. The last vowel u is a back vowel, so -ma and -nız: unutmanız.

items.translation: If you don't pay the bill, the service will be suspended.
items.explanation: takdirde → -DIk. The negation me goes before it: öde + me + diğiniz. Front vowels, so e and i.

items.translation: If you don't follow the rules, you'll be removed from the festival.
items.explanation: uy has the back vowel u, negation ma, then -dığınız. mamanız is the partner of durumunda, not takdirde.

items.text: Otelden geç çık___ takdirde ek ücret ödersiniz.
items.translation: If you check out of the hotel late, you'll pay a surcharge.
items.explanation: çık ends in voiceless k — d becomes t: çıktığınız.

exercises.instruction: Sort the forms: which goes before takdirde, which before durumunda

items.explanation: Don't mix up the pairs: -DIğI (ödediğiniz, gördüğün) → takdirde; -mAsI (kaybetmeniz, çıkması) → durumunda or hâlinde.

items.translation: If you don't pay, the service will be suspended.
items.explanation: Ödemediğiniz takdirde — the condition, then the consequence: hizmet durdurulur.
Yangın çıkması durumunda — the fire is indefinite, so no -ın. Then the instruction: 112'yi arayın.

items.translation: If you see a bear, walk away slowly.
items.explanation: görmeniz = gör + me + niz. The partner of durumunda is the -mA form.

exercises.instruction: Camp print shop: type the word for the notice from pieces
exercises.description: Five notices for a festival in the forest near Samsun. Each one is missing a word — you have to type it out of morphemes in the right order.

items.explanation: Bileti kaybettiğiniz takdirde: kaybet ends in voiceless t, so -tiğiniz.
Yangın çıkması durumunda: durumunda takes -mA + owner, for the fire that's -sı.
teslim etmediğiniz takdirde: negation me, then -diğiniz.
Otobüsü kaçırmanız hâlinde: hâlinde is the twin of durumunda, also with -mA.
Misafirlerin geç kalmaları durumunda: the owner is “they” — -ları.

items.statement: In the “-DIğI takdirde” construction, takdirde means “we appreciate.”
items.explanation: takdir etmek means “to appreciate,” but takdirde after -DIk means “in case.”

items.prompt: How do you say “if they come”?
items.explanation: Before -leri, k doesn't soften: gel + dik + leri = geldikleri.

items.prompt: How do you say “in case you (sen) don't call” (aramak)?
items.explanation: durumunda → -mA + owner. The negation is ma too: ara + ma + ma + n.
yap ends in voiceless p, so d becomes voiceless: yaptığınız.

items.prompt: Where does “-DIğI takdirde” sound most appropriate?
options: in a text to a friend
items.explanation: takdirde is an official tone: contracts, rules, notices. For a friend, -sA is enough.
